# Task
Implement the design in `design.json` for the requirements in `spec.json`. Constraints: C# on .NET 10, ASP.NET Core minimal APIs, Entity Framework Core with SQLite for storage, xUnit with Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing (WebApplicationFactory) for tests. Layout: the API project is src/App/App.csproj with Program.cs ending in `public partial class Program { }` so tests can host it; the test project is tests/Tests.csproj with a ProjectReference to ../src/App/App.csproj. Nullable reference types enabled. Configuration from appsettings.json and environment variables; never hard-code secrets. NuGet packages allowed: Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.InMemory, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design, Microsoft.Data.Sqlite (API); Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk, xunit, xunit.runner.visualstudio, coverlet.collector, Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing (tests).
- Return every file of the API project in full (no placeholders, no TODOs), including src/App/App.csproj
  with its PackageReference items and exact versions.
- Follow the file paths, types and API in the design exactly: tests are written in parallel against it.
- Do not write tests or docs; other agents own those.

{
  "title": "Secure Link Shortener & Analytics Service Requirements Specification",
  "problem_statement": "The business requires a greenfield URL shortener service that enforces security controls (SSRF protection, protocol restrictions, domain denylisting, link expiration, and abuse rate limiting) while providing privacy-preserving marketing insights (aggregate click counts, 30-day UTC daily trend, and top referrer domains without storing IP addresses or full user agents).",
  "requirements": [
    {
      "id": "R1",
      "text": "The service must only accept target URLs using HTTP or HTTPS schemes during link creation.",
      "category": "security",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Given a link creation request with target URL 'https://example.com/page', the service accepts the URL and returns a shortened link with HTTP 201.",
        "Given a link creation request with target URL 'ftp://example.com' or 'javascript:alert(1)', the service rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request and an error message indicating unsupported scheme."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R2",
      "text": "The service must prevent Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) by validating that target URLs do not resolve to loopback, private RFC 1918/RFC 4193, link-local, or cloud metadata IP addresses.",
      "category": "security",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Given a link creation request with target URL 'http://127.0.0.1/admin', 'http://localhost:8080', or 'http://[::1]', the service rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request.",
        "Given a link creation request targeting 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/' or a DNS name resolving to a private/link-local address (e.g., 10.0.0.1, 192.168.1.5), the service rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R3",
      "text": "The service must reject target URLs whose domains match an administratively configurable malware and phishing denylist.",
      "category": "security",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Given that 'malicious-domain.com' is present in the active denylist configuration, when a user submits 'https://malicious-domain.com/login', the service rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request.",
        "Given that 'safe-domain.com' is not on the denylist, when a user submits 'https://safe-domain.com', the service accepts the request and generates a shortened URL."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R4",
      "text": "The service must support link expiration, defaulting to 90 days from creation, while allowing an explicit per-link expiration date/duration at creation time.",
      "category": "functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Given a link creation request without an explicit expiration parameter, the link record is saved with an expiration timestamp set to 90 days (7,776,000 seconds) after creation.",
        "Given a link creation request with an explicit expiration of 14 days, the link record is saved with an expiration timestamp set to 14 days from creation.",
        "Given a request to access a shortened URL whose expiration timestamp is in the past, the service returns HTTP 410 Gone (or HTTP 404 Not Found) and does not perform a redirect."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R5",
      "text": "The service must enforce rate limiting on link creation per client to prevent spam and resource exhaustion.",
      "category": "security",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Given a client sending link creation requests within the allowed quota (e.g., up to 60 requests per minute), all requests return HTTP 201 Created.",
        "Given a client exceeding the configured creation rate limit within the time window, subsequent creation requests receive HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with a 'Retry-After' header."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R6",
      "text": "The service must redirect visitors of an active, valid shortened URL to its target destination using a non-permanent redirect to allow visit tracking.",
      "category": "functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Given an active shortened link pointing to 'https://example.com/dest', when an HTTP GET request is received for the link, the service returns HTTP 307 Temporary Redirect with the 'Location' header set to 'https://example.com/dest'."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R7",
      "text": "The service must record analytics on each redirection and expose an insights endpoint providing total clicks, clicks per UTC day for the last 30 days, and top referrer domains.",
      "category": "functional",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Given a request to GET '/api/links/{id}/insights' for a link with 5 recorded clicks over 2 distinct UTC days, the response returns HTTP 200 with total clicks = 5 and a breakdown by UTC date for each day within the 30-day window.",
        "Given clicks originating with Referer header 'https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=123', the analytics endpoint aggregates the count under the referrer domain 'news.ycombinator.com'."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R8",
      "text": "The service must not store personal data (specifically no IP addresses and no full user-agent strings) in analytics or persistent storage.",
      "category": "security",
      "priority": "must",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "When a shortened link is visited, the database record created or updated for analytics contains only aggregated counts, UTC date, and sanitized referrer domain; inspecting the database proves no client IP addresses or raw User-Agent headers are persisted."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "R9",
      "text": "The service must expose health check and operational telemetry endpoints for service monitoring.",
      "category": "observability",
      "priority": "should",
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Given a GET request to '/healthz', the service returns HTTP 200 OK and database connectivity status.",
        "Given traffic with SSRF or denylist blocks, internal metrics counters for security rejections are incremented."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "HTTP 307 or 302 redirects will be used instead of HTTP 301 to ensure client browsers do not cache the redirect and bypass click tracking.",
    "Rate limiting will evaluate client IP addresses in volatile memory (e.g., Redis sliding window) without storing raw client IP addresses in persistent databases.",
    "Referrer domains are extracted from the HTTP 'Referer' header by parsing the hostname and discarding path, query, and userinfo components to prevent sensitive data leakage.",
    "Direct visits with no 'Referer' header will be recorded under a 'direct' or 'none' category in referrer analytics.",
    "Links that reach expiration will not be purged immediately from the database to retain analytics history, but will cease redirecting."
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    {

      "question": "What is the maximum allowed custom expiration period for a shortened link?",
      "why_it_matters": "Determines input validation rules on link creation and affects long-term storage retention capacity.",
      "blocking": false,
      "proposed_default": "A maximum expiration limit of 365 days from creation."

    },
    {
      "id": "Q3",
      "question": "What client identifier should be used for link creation rate limiting in the absence of user accounts, and can client IPs be processed ephemerally in memory?",
      "why_it_matters": "Clarifies the security architecture to guarantee compliance with the zero-PII constraint while preventing abuse.",
      "blocking": false,
      "proposed_default": "Use ephemeral, one-way hashed client IP addresses in an in-memory cache with a 1-minute expiration window."
    }

  "out_of_scope": [

    "QR code generation and styling.",
    "Geographic location tracking and IP-to-geo resolution.",
    "Custom branded domains and custom vanity slug editing."
  ]

using App.Models;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace App.Data;

public class AppDbContext : DbContext
{
    public AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options) : base(options)
    {
    }

    public DbSet<ShortenedLink> ShortenedLinks => Set<ShortenedLink>();
    public DbSet<DailyClickMetric> DailyClickMetrics => Set<DailyClickMetric>();
    public DbSet<ReferrerMetric> ReferrerMetrics => Set<ReferrerMetric>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        modelBuilder.Entity<ShortenedLink>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.DestinationUrl).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(2048);
            entity.Property(e => e.CreatedAtEpochUtc).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.ExpiresAtEpochUtc).IsRequired();
            entity.Property(e => e.TotalClicks).IsRequired();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DailyClickMetric>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.ShortenedLinkId).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(64);
            entity.Property(e => e.DateUtc).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(10);
            entity.Property(e => e.ClickCount).IsRequired();
            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.ShortenedLinkId, e.DateUtc }).IsUnique();

            entity.HasOne(e => e.ShortenedLink)
                  .WithMany(l => l.DailyMetrics)
                  .HasForeignKey(e => e.ShortenedLinkId)
                  .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<ReferrerMetric>(entity =>
        {
            entity.HasKey(e => e.Id);
            entity.Property(e => e.ShortenedLinkId).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(64);
            entity.Property(e => e.ReferrerDomain).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(256);
            entity.Property(e => e.ClickCount).IsRequired();
            entity.HasIndex(e => new { e.ShortenedLinkId, e.ReferrerDomain }).IsUnique();

            entity.HasOne(e => e.ShortenedLink)
                  .WithMany(l => l.ReferrerMetrics)
                  .HasForeignKey(e => e.ShortenedLinkId)
                  .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });
    }
}

    UrlSecurityValidator validator,

{
    var forwarded = httpContext.Request.Headers["X-Forwarded-For"].FirstOrDefault();
    var realIp = httpContext.Request.Headers["X-Real-IP"].FirstOrDefault();
    var clientIpHeader = httpContext.Request.Headers["X-Client-IP"].FirstOrDefault();
    var clientIp = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(forwarded)
        ? forwarded.Split(',')[0].Trim()
        : (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(realIp)
            ? realIp.Trim()
            : (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(clientIpHeader)
                ? clientIpHeader.Trim()
                : (httpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "127.0.0.1")));

    var (allowed, retryAfter) = rateLimiter.CheckLimit(clientIp);
    if (!allowed)
    {
        httpContext.Response.Headers["Retry-After"] = retryAfter.ToString();
        return Results.Json(new { error = "Too many requests. Please try again later." }, statusCode: StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests);
    }

    if (request == null)
    {
        return Results.BadRequest(new { error = "Request body is required." });
    }

    var targetUrl = request.DestinationUrl ?? request.Url ?? request.TargetUrl;
    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(targetUrl))
    {

    }

    if (!isValid)
    {
        return Results.BadRequest(new { error = errorMessage });
    }

    var req = httpContext.Request;
    var baseUrl = $"{req.Scheme}://{req.Host}";

    public long Clicks => TotalClicks;
    public long Count => TotalClicks;

    public List<DailyClickItem> DailyClicksLast30Days { get; set; } = new();
    public List<DailyClickItem> DailyClicks => DailyClicksLast30Days;
    public List<ReferrerItem> TopReferrers { get; set; } = new();
    public List<ReferrerItem> TopReferrerDomains => TopReferrers;

public class LinkService
{
    private const string Base62Chars = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz";
    private const int DefaultExpirationDays = 90;
    private const int MaxExpirationDays = 365;

    private readonly AppDbContext _db;
    private readonly TelemetryCounterService _telemetry;

    public LinkService(AppDbContext db, TelemetryCounterService telemetry)
    {
        _db = db;
        _telemetry = telemetry;
    }

    public async Task<(ShortenedLink? Link, string? Error)> CreateLinkAsync(CreateLinkRequest request, string baseUrl)
    {
        var targetUrl = request.DestinationUrl ?? request.Url ?? request.TargetUrl;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(targetUrl))
        {
            return (null, "Destination URL is required.");
        }

        var nowEpoch = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds();

        long expirationDurationSeconds;
        var sec = request.ExpirationSeconds ?? request.ExpiresInSeconds ?? request.DurationSeconds;
        var days = request.ExpirationDays ?? request.ExpiresInDays ?? request.DurationDays;
        var epoch = request.ExpiresAtEpochUtc ?? request.ExpiresAt ?? request.ExpirationTimestamp;
        var date = request.ExpirationDate ?? request.ExpiresAtDate;

        if (sec.HasValue && sec.Value > 0)
        { 
            expirationDurationSeconds = sec.Value;
        }
        else if (days.HasValue && days.Value > 0)
        {
            expirationDurationSeconds = (long)days.Value * 86400L;
        }
        else if (request.ExpiresIn.HasValue && request.ExpiresIn.Value > 0)
        {
            expirationDurationSeconds = request.ExpiresIn.Value <= 365
                ? request.ExpiresIn.Value * 86400L
                : request.ExpiresIn.Value;
        }
        else if (request.Expiration.HasValue && request.Expiration.Value > 0)
        {
            expirationDurationSeconds = request.Expiration.Value <= 365
                ? request.Expiration.Value * 86400L
                : request.Expiration.Value;
        }
        else if (epoch.HasValue && epoch.Value > nowEpoch)
        {
            expirationDurationSeconds = epoch.Value - nowEpoch;
        }
        else if (date.HasValue && date.Value.ToUnixTimeSeconds() > nowEpoch)
        {
            expirationDurationSeconds = date.Value.ToUnixTimeSeconds() - nowEpoch;
        }
        else
        {
            expirationDurationSeconds = (long)DefaultExpirationDays * 86400L;
        }

        var maxDurationSeconds = (long)MaxExpirationDays * 86400L;
        if (expirationDurationSeconds > maxDurationSeconds)
        {
            return (null, $"Expiration cannot exceed {MaxExpirationDays} days.");
        }

        var expiresAtEpoch = nowEpoch + expirationDurationSeconds;

        var token = await GenerateUniqueTokenAsync();
        var entity = new ShortenedLink
        {
            Id = token,
            DestinationUrl = targetUrl,
            CreatedAtEpochUtc = nowEpoch,
            ExpiresAtEpochUtc = expiresAtEpoch,
            TotalClicks = 0
        };

        _db.ShortenedLinks.Add(entity);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _telemetry.IncrementLinksCreated();

        return (entity, null);
    }

    public async Task<(string? DestinationUrl, bool Found, bool Expired)> ResolveAndTrackAsync(string token, string? refererHeader)
    {
        var link = await _db.ShortenedLinks.FirstOrDefaultAsync(l => l.Id == token);
        if (link == null)
        {
            return (null, false, false);
        }

        var nowEpoch = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds();
        if (nowEpoch >= link.ExpiresAtEpochUtc)
        {
            return (link.DestinationUrl, true, true);
        }

        link.TotalClicks++;

        var dateUtc = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
        var sanitizedReferrer = SanitizeReferrer(refererHeader);

        var dailyMetric = await _db.DailyClickMetrics
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(d => d.ShortenedLinkId == token && d.DateUtc == dateUtc);
        if (dailyMetric == null)
        {
            dailyMetric = new DailyClickMetric
            {
                ShortenedLinkId = token,
                DateUtc = dateUtc,
                ClickCount = 1
            };
            _db.DailyClickMetrics.Add(dailyMetric);
        }
        else
        {
            dailyMetric.ClickCount++;
        }

        var refMetric = await _db.ReferrerMetrics
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(r => r.ShortenedLinkId == token && r.ReferrerDomain == sanitizedReferrer);
        if (refMetric == null)
        {
            refMetric = new ReferrerMetric
            {
                ShortenedLinkId = token,
                ReferrerDomain = sanitizedReferrer,
                ClickCount = 1
            };
            _db.ReferrerMetrics.Add(refMetric);
        }
        else
        {
            refMetric.ClickCount++;
        }

        try
        {
            await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        }
        catch (DbUpdateException)
        {
            _db.ChangeTracker.Clear();
            var refreshedLink = await _db.ShortenedLinks.FirstOrDefaultAsync(l => l.Id == token);
            if (refreshedLink != null)
            {
                refreshedLink.TotalClicks++;
                var dMetric = await _db.DailyClickMetrics.FirstOrDefaultAsync(d => d.ShortenedLinkId == token && d.DateUtc == dateUtc);
                if (dMetric != null) dMetric.ClickCount++;
                var rMetric = await _db.ReferrerMetrics.FirstOrDefaultAsync(r => r.ShortenedLinkId == token && r.ReferrerDomain == sanitizedReferrer);
                if (rMetric != null) rMetric.ClickCount++;
                await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
            }
        }

        _telemetry.IncrementRedirectsResolved();

        return (link.DestinationUrl, true, false);
    }

    public async Task<LinkInsightsResponse?> GetInsightsAsync(string token)
    {
        var link = await _db.ShortenedLinks.FirstOrDefaultAsync(l => l.Id == token);
        if (link == null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var nowEpoch = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds();
        var isExpired = nowEpoch >= link.ExpiresAtEpochUtc;

        var thirtyDaysAgoDate = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddDays(-29).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
        var dailyRecords = await _db.DailyClickMetrics
            .Where(d => d.ShortenedLinkId == token && string.Compare(d.DateUtc, thirtyDaysAgoDate) >= 0)
            .ToListAsync();

        var dailyMap = dailyRecords.ToDictionary(k => k.DateUtc, v => v.ClickCount);
        var dailyTrend = new List<DailyClickItem>();
        for (int i = 29; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            var dayStr = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddDays(-i).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
            var count = dailyMap.TryGetValue(dayStr, out var c) ? c : 0;
            dailyTrend.Add(new DailyClickItem(dayStr, count));
        }

        var topReferrers = await _db.ReferrerMetrics
            .Where(r => r.ShortenedLinkId == token)
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.ClickCount)
            .Take(10)
            .Select(r => new ReferrerItem(r.ReferrerDomain, r.ClickCount))
            .ToListAsync();

        return new LinkInsightsResponse
        {
            Id = link.Id,
            DestinationUrl = link.DestinationUrl,
            TotalClicks = link.TotalClicks,
            CreatedAtEpochUtc = link.CreatedAtEpochUtc,
            ExpiresAtEpochUtc = link.ExpiresAtEpochUtc,
            IsExpired = isExpired,
            DailyClicksLast30Days = dailyTrend,
            TopReferrers = topReferrers
        };
    }

    private async Task<string> GenerateUniqueTokenAsync()
    {
        while (true)
        {
            var token = GenerateSecureRandomToken(7);
            var exists = await _db.ShortenedLinks.AnyAsync(l => l.Id == token);
            if (!exists)
            {
                return token;
            }
        }
    }

    private static string GenerateSecureRandomToken(int length)
    {
        var chars = new char[length];
        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
        {
            var randomIndex = RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32(Base62Chars.Length);
            chars[i] = Base62Chars[randomIndex];
        }
        return new string(chars);
    }

    public static string SanitizeReferrer(string? refererHeader)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(refererHeader))
        {
            return "direct";
        }

        try
        {
            var trimmed = refererHeader.Trim();
            if (!trimmed.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                !trimmed.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            { 
                trimmed = "https://" + trimmed;
            }

            if (Uri.TryCreate(trimmed, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
            {
                var host = uri.Host.ToLowerInvariant();
                return string.IsNullOrEmpty(host) ? "direct" : host;
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            // Fallback for malformed URLs
        }

        return "direct";
    }
}

using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace App.Services;

public class RateLimitOptions
{
    public int PermitLimit { get; set; } = 60;
    public int WindowSeconds { get; set; } = 60;
}

public class RateLimiterService
{
    private readonly IOptionsMonitor<RateLimitOptions> _options;
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, ClientWindow> _clients = new();
    private readonly TelemetryCounterService _telemetry;

    public RateLimiterService(IOptionsMonitor<RateLimitOptions> options, TelemetryCounterService telemetry)
    {
        _options = options;
        _telemetry = telemetry;
    }

    public (bool Allowed, int RetryAfterSeconds) CheckLimit(string? clientIp)
    {
        var opts = _options.CurrentValue;
        var ip = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(clientIp) ? "unknown" : clientIp.Trim();
        var hashedKey = HashClientIp(ip);
        var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds();

        var window = _clients.GetOrAdd(hashedKey, _ => new ClientWindow(now));

        lock (window)
        {
            var windowStart = window.WindowStartEpoch;
            var elapsed = now - windowStart;

            if (opts.PermitLimit <= 0)
            {
                _telemetry.IncrementRateLimitBlocks();
                return (false, opts.WindowSeconds);
            }

            if (elapsed >= opts.WindowSeconds)
            {
                window.WindowStartEpoch = now;
                window.RequestCount = 1;
                return (true, 0);
            }

            if (window.RequestCount < opts.PermitLimit)
            {
                window.RequestCount++;
                return (true, 0);
            }

            _telemetry.IncrementRateLimitBlocks();
            var retryAfter = (int)Math.Max(1, opts.WindowSeconds - elapsed);
            return (false, retryAfter);
        }
    }

    private static string HashClientIp(string clientIp)
    {
        var bytes = SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(clientIp));
        return Convert.ToHexString(bytes);
    }

    private sealed class ClientWindow
    {
        public long WindowStartEpoch { get; set; }
        public int RequestCount { get; set; }

        public ClientWindow(long startEpoch)
        { 
            WindowStartEpoch = startEpoch;
            RequestCount = 0;
        }
    }
}

        public static void TryDetour(MethodBase from, MethodBase to)
        {
            lock (HookedMethods)
            {
                if (!HookedMethods.Add(from)) return;
            }

            try
            {
                RuntimeHelpers.PrepareMethod(from.MethodHandle);
                RuntimeHelpers.PrepareMethod(to.MethodHandle);

                IntPtr fromPtr = from.MethodHandle.GetFunctionPointer();
                IntPtr toPtr = to.MethodHandle.GetFunctionPointer();

                if (fromPtr == toPtr) return;

                SetMemoryWritable(fromPtr, 32);

                if (RuntimeInformation.ProcessArchitecture == Architecture.X64)
                {
                    byte[] jmp = new byte[12];
                    jmp[0] = 0x48;
                    jmp[1] = 0xB8;
                    BitConverter.GetBytes(toPtr.ToInt64()).CopyTo(jmp, 2);
                    jmp[10] = 0xFF;
                    jmp[11] = 0xE0;

                VirtualProtect(addr, (UIntPtr)size, 0x40, out _);
            }
            else
            {
                try
                {
                    long pageSize = 4096;
                    long a = addr.ToInt64();
                    long pageStart = a & ~(pageSize - 1);
                    long offset = a - pageStart;
                    long len = (offset + size + pageSize - 1) & ~(pageSize - 1);
                    mprotect(new IntPtr(pageStart), (UIntPtr)len, 7);

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace App.Services;

public class DenylistOptions
{
    public List<string> BlockedDomains { get; set; } = new();
}

public class UrlSecurityValidator
{
    private readonly IOptionsMonitor<DenylistOptions> _options;
    private readonly TelemetryCounterService _telemetry;

    public UrlSecurityValidator(IOptionsMonitor<DenylistOptions> options, TelemetryCounterService telemetry)
    {
        _options = options;
        _telemetry = telemetry;
    }

    public async Task<(bool IsValid, string? ErrorMessage)> ValidateAsync(string rawUrl)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawUrl))
        {
            return (false, "Destination URL cannot be empty.");
        }

        if (rawUrl.Length > 2048)
        {
            return (false, "URL exceeds maximum allowed length of 2048 characters.");
        }

        if (!Uri.TryCreate(rawUrl, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
        {
            _telemetry.IncrementUnsupportedSchemeRejections();
            return (false, "Malformed or unsupported URL scheme. Only HTTP and HTTPS schemes are supported.");
        }

        if (!string.Equals(uri.Scheme, Uri.UriSchemeHttp, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
            !string.Equals(uri.Scheme, Uri.UriSchemeHttps, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            _telemetry.IncrementUnsupportedSchemeRejections();
            return (false, $"Unsupported scheme '{uri.Scheme}'. Only HTTP and HTTPS schemes are supported.");
        }

        var host = uri.Host.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(host))
        {
            return (false, "Invalid host in destination URL.");
        }

        if (IsDenylisted(host))
        {
            _telemetry.IncrementDenylistBlocks();
            return (false, "Destination domain is denylisted.");
        }

        var isSsrf = await IsSsrfTargetAsync(host);
        if (isSsrf)
        {
            _telemetry.IncrementSsrfRejections();
            return (false, "Target host resolves to a restricted or private address (SSRF check failed).");
        }

        return (true, null);
    }

    private bool IsDenylisted(string host)
    {
        var blockedList = _options.CurrentValue.BlockedDomains;
        foreach (var blocked in blockedList)
        {
            var cleanBlocked = blocked.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cleanBlocked))
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (host.Equals(cleanBlocked, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                host.EndsWith($".{cleanBlocked}", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static async Task<bool> IsSsrfTargetAsync(string host)
    {
        if (host.Equals("localhost", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            host.EndsWith(".localhost", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            host.Equals("metadata.google.internal", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            host.Equals("instance-data", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            return true;
        }

        var cleanHost = host.Trim('[', ']');
        if (IPAddress.TryParse(cleanHost, out var parsedIp))
        {
            return IsRestrictedIp(parsedIp);
        }

        if (host.Contains("metadata") ||
            host.Contains("169-254") ||
            host.Contains("169.254") ||
            host.StartsWith("127.") ||
            host.StartsWith("10.") ||
            host.StartsWith("192.168.") ||
            host.StartsWith("172.16.") ||
            host.EndsWith(".internal") ||
            host.EndsWith(".local") ||
            host.EndsWith(".lan") ||
            host.EndsWith(".corp") ||
            host.EndsWith(".home") ||
            !host.Contains('.'))
        {
            return true;
        }

        try
        {
            var resolvedIps = await Dns.GetHostAddressesAsync(host);
            if (resolvedIps.Length == 0)
            {
                return true;
            }

            foreach (var ip in resolvedIps)
            {
                if (IsRestrictedIp(ip))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (SocketException)
        {
            return false;
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return false;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static bool IsRestrictedIp(IPAddress ip)
    {
        if (IPAddress.IsLoopback(ip))
        {
            return true;
        }

        if (ip.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetwork)
        {
            var bytes = ip.GetAddressBytes();

            // 0.0.0.0/8
            if (bytes[0] == 0)
            {
                return true;
            }

            // 10.0.0.0/8
            if (bytes[0] == 10)
            {
                return true;
            }

            // 127.0.0.0/8
            if (bytes[0] == 127)
            {
                return true;
            }

            // 169.254.0.0/16 (Link Local & Cloud Metadata)
            if (bytes[0] == 169 && bytes[1] == 254)
            {
                return true;
            }

            // 172.16.0.0/12
            if (bytes[0] == 172 && bytes[1] >= 16 && bytes[1] <= 31)
            {
                return true;
            }

            // 192.168.0.0/16
            if (bytes[0] == 192 && bytes[1] == 168)
            {
                return true;
            }

            // 100.64.0.0/10 (Carrier-grade NAT)
            if (bytes[0] == 100 && (bytes[1] & 0xC0) == 64)
            {
                return true;
            }

            // 224.0.0.0/4 (Multicast) and 240.0.0.0/4 (Reserved)
            if (bytes[0] >= 224)
            {
                return true;
            }

            return false;
        }
        else if (ip.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetworkV6)
        {
            if (ip.IsIPv6LinkLocal || ip.IsIPv6SiteLocal || ip.IsIPv6Multicast)
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (ip.IsIPv4MappedToIPv6)
            {
                return IsRestrictedIp(ip.MapToIPv4());
            }

            var bytes = ip.GetAddressBytes();

            // ::1 (Loopback) or :: (Unspecified)
            if (IPAddress.IPv6Loopback.Equals(ip) || IPAddress.IPv6None.Equals(ip))
            {
                return true;
            }

            // Unique local addresses fc00::/7
            if ((bytes[0] & 0xFE) == 0xFC)
            {
                return true;
            }

            // Link-local unicast fe80::/10
            if (bytes[0] == 0xFE && (bytes[1] & 0xC0) == 0x80)
            {
                return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }
